pages.title: Genome Sample
pages.text: A vial of clear fluid with every instruction for building one creature written in four chemical letters. It looks like water. It is the most information-dense thing I have ever casually put in my pocket.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Gene Sampler's first touch filled a vial with a creature's complete genome. Sequencing it showed the same alphabet as my own, which was both expected and moving.

Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Nuclear Pore chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Genomics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bacteriophage, Circadian Culture, Engineered Enzyme, Evolved Strain, Messenger RNA, Recombinant DNA, Ribosome Assembler, Stem Cell Culture and more.
